description.content:
Obtain a list of pre-registered payees.

Obsolete versions: [v1](includes/obsolete/get-payees-v1.html).

query.description: Filter on the payee _type_ field. In addition to normal _type_ field values, `ALL` can be specified to retrieve all payees. If absent the assumed value is `ALL`.
Page of results to request (standard pagination).
Page size to request. Default is 25 (standard pagination).
